common.style_usage: the Stardew Valley pixel art style and colours of Tobin's pottery: warm brick and wood ramps, dark coloured (never black) outlines, clean flat shading

backdrop.reference_usage: the layout to follow exactly: plank wall, a long shelf of pots near the top, a brick kiln with its glowing mouth at the right edge, a plank floor along the bottom
backdrop.description: Stardew Valley pixel art, a close-up of a potter's workshop wall seen straight on at eye level, as the background of a minigame: a warm wooden plank wall, a long wooden shelf near the top with a row of glazed pots, jars and bowls in terracotta, slate blue and slip white, a brick kiln at the right edge with its arched mouth glowing orange, a wooden plank floor along the bottom. The middle is plain wall, slightly dim, with nothing in front of it, so a pot on a wheel in front reads clearly. No people, no wheel, no furniture in the middle.

wheel.reference_usage: Tobin's potter's wheel: its wood and grey wheel head
wheel.description: Stardew Valley pixel art, one object alone on a transparent background, seen straight from the front at eye level, close up and perfectly symmetrical: a potter's kick wheel. A flat round grey metal wheel head on top, seen edge-on as a thin wide disc, with nothing on it; a wide shallow round wooden splash pan around it; a sturdy wooden frame with two legs; a heavy round wooden kick wheel low down between the legs. Warm wood, dark coloured (not black) outlines.

hands.description: Stardew Valley pixel art, one item alone on a transparent background, close up, seen from the front: a pair of human hands wet with grey-brown clay slip, as a potter's hands at the wheel: cupped together as if holding a round lump between them, or one hand from each side pressing inward, or fingertips curled pulling upward, or palms flat. Warm skin, dark coloured (not black) outlines, simple clean shading.
